subject: Re: Sferic - licking a front paw raw-ish

facts.plan: vet volunteers review; circle back tomorrow; watch appetite/pain

body:
Hi Gavin!

Thank you so much for flagging this! You did exactly the right thing by reaching out.

I'm passing your note to our vet volunteers now so they can review it, and I'll circle back with you tomorrow morning with their thoughts and next steps.

In the meantime, just keep an eye on him. Watch his appetite, and look for any signs of pain (wincing when you touch the paw, limping, not wanting to walk). If either of those changes, let me know right away!

Glad to hear he's still eating, drinking and walking fine. That's a good sign!

Dana

And hear me on this: SOFT LANDINGS COUNT. You gave Tuff a safe place when he needed one, and that matters more than you think. (Ask me how many fosters I've had boomerang back to me!)

Dana

One snag: I didn't get any beach photos, and I'm guessing they were too large to attach (our inbox is picky, sorry!). Could you share a link instead? I'd LOVE to see him covered in sand.

Hugs to Bowie!
